chunks: And it is narrated from Jabir al-Ja'fi who said:

I asked Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him): 'When will your relief (or emergence) be?' He replied: 'Far off, far off! Our relief will not come until you are sieved, then sieved, then sieved,' he said it three times, 'until the dross is removed by Allah (the Exalted) and only the pure remains.'
ai.seo_question: What is the meaning of 'sifting' or 'sieving' in the context of the occultation?
ai.summary: In this narration from Shaykh al-Tusi’s *Kitab al-Ghayba*, Imam al-Baqir (a.s.) uses the metaphor of sieving three times to illustrate the gradual purification of the Shia community during the Major Occultation. This process distinguishes the steadfast 'pure' believers from the 'impure' who falter under pressure, ensuring that the final relief comes only when the community is spiritually refined and ready for the Imam's return.

en.sayyid-athar-husain-s-h-rizvi: H 287 - It is narrated from Jabir Jofi that he said:

I asked Imam Muhammad Baqir (a.s): “When will you come to power?” He replied: “It’s a pity that it will not be so till you are all sieved like grain is sieved to separate it from chaff. And then you are sieved again and again, till there does not remain any impurity and only the clean grain is left.”
